name: NF-A6x25 FLX
description: The Noctua NF-A6x25 FLX is a premium 60×25mm axial fan commonly used for electronics bay cooling or as a board/PSU fan in larger 3D printers. It delivers considerably more airflow than the 40mm variants while remaining quiet, and shares the same SSO2 bearing technology and long-lived build quality found across the Noctua lineup.
